topic: what faynoSync is, its process modes and how it boots (config/env, secrets check, Mongo+Redis, optional modules)
hint: faynoSync.go dispatches on args: none=StartServer, healthcheck, migrate up|down; config is viper .env + AutomaticEnv. StartServer runs validateSecrets (JWT_SECRET/API_KEY dev-default prefix is fatal in gin release mode), requires Redis, and gates /signup on API_KEY, /reports/* on REPORTS_ENABLED, TUF on TUF_ENABLED, dashboard on DASHBOARD_ENABLED.

topic: how an HTTP request reaches its handler: route table, middleware order, appHandler wrapper
hint: In server.go routes registered BEFORE router.Use(authMiddleware) (checkVersion, apps/latest, login, signup, download, telemetry/beacon, velopack, RELEASES, reports/ingest) are public; everything after is authenticated. corsMiddleware is Use()d after dashboard.Register. handler.go is a thin appHandler delegating to subpackages under server/handler/*.

topic: how auth and permissions are enforced (session JWT, fns_ API tokens, team users, CheckPermission, AdminOnly, app scope)
hint: AuthMiddleware tries ParseSessionJWT then falls back to fns_ API tokens looked up by hash in api_tokens; API tokens are mapped to an admin Principal with allowed_apps. AuthMiddleware is a no-op if a Principal is already in context (routes list it twice). Team users resolve to an owner via ResolveRequestOwner/ResolveOwnerMiddleware.

topic: how to add a new API endpoint (handler package, appHandler method, route + permission middleware, repository method)
hint: Touch points: handler subpackage func, method on appHandler in handler.go, route in server.go with CheckPermission(Permission*, Resource*), and AppRepository interface in mongod/adapter.go + implementation file in mongod/. TUF routes are separate in server/tuf/tuf.go.

topic: update check: how /checkVersion resolves latest version, per-updater response shape, and Redis response cache/invalidation
hint: updaters.BuildResponse switches on updaterType (squirrel_darwin returns 204 without update_url_zip; squirrel_windows 302 redirect to RELEASES). Cache keys built by CreateCacheKey/CacheKeyPattern in latest.go; upload.go InvalidateCache* clears them. Worker should verify rollback/critical-version handling.

topic: feed-based updaters: Sparkle appcast and Velopack feeds (upload parsing, materialization, serving)
hint: upload.go detects feed files by name (isVelopackFeedName/isSparkleAppcastName), ParseVelopackFeed/ParseSparkleAppcast; velopack route is /velopack/:owner/:app/:platform/:arch/*feed and is public.

topic: upload and publish pipeline: multipart vs presigned upload, validation, storage backends, DB writes, cache invalidation
hint: Two upload paths: POST /upload and /upload/init + /upload/complete (pending_uploads with TTL index per migration). Storage provider chosen in storage/factory.go among aws/minio/gcs/digitalocean. Worker should verify the ordering of storage write, DB insert and InvalidatePublishCaches.

topic: private downloads: /download, download tokens, per-app access, report keys
hint: GET /download sits outside authMiddleware on purpose (comment in server.go): access decided per app in the handler; CORS allows X-Download-Token header.

topic: TUF integration: bootstrap, metadata signing/rotation, online role bumping, artifact publish tasks
hint: Only enabled with TUF_ENABLED; StartServer also launches StartOnlineRolesBumper. Routes in tuf.go are all /tuf/v1/*; admin-only for bootstrap/config/metadata, app edit permission + owner resolution for artifacts publish/delete and task. Publish/delete are async tasks polled via GET /tuf/v1/task (Redis).

topic: telemetry, crash reports and Redis-backed stats
hint: Gated by ENABLE_TELEMETRY (telemetryMiddleware returns 403) and REPORTS_ENABLED; /reports/ingest is public (outside auth), group/list/manage routes are authenticated.

topic: MongoDB layer: AppRepository, structs/models, migrations, team permissions
hint: Migrations are golang-migrate JSON files in mongod/migrations, run only via `faynoSync migrate up|down` (not on boot).

topic: embedded dashboard (React/Vite) served by the Go binary and its hooks
hint: dashboard.go go:embeds all:ui; Register is called before cors/auth middleware; TUFMetadataURL passed from DASHBOARD_TUF_METADATA_URL.
